Terms

Clear terms for buying with confidence.

These practical terms apply to enquiries and purchases made through Increase Original Super Store branches and WhatsApp channels.

Prices and availability

Prices, stock, device condition, storage, colour and included accessories can change. A listing or catalogue entry is not a guarantee that an item remains available. Confirm the exact details with the branch before payment.

Inspection and fulfilment

Confirm the pickup location, delivery destination, timing and any delivery charge before payment. If you want to inspect a device, contact the branch first so the exact item can be checked for availability.

Product information

Product names and descriptions are provided to help you start an enquiry. Ask the sales team to confirm the exact model, condition, storage and accessories that will be supplied.

Contact

Questions about a specific order should be directed to the branch that handled your enquiry. Use the contact page for the current branch numbers and directions.
